author: claude
about: Hand-written probes aimed at known weak spots (paraphrases, negations, keywords in bad answers, short answers, trap numbers). Expected grades are Claude's judgment, not the analyst's.

answers.text: From year 13 the wind farm has no contract and sells at whatever the market pays; I priced that at 6.0 cents, below the developer's view, and kept the loan inside the contract term.
Spot prices have risen three years in a row, so 7.6 cents is fine and 18 years is OK.
Not the sponsor's 7.6 cents but the low case of 6.0 cents, so a 12-year tenor.
Once the manufacturer's cover expires after year five, O&M will cost around USD 3.0m, which eats into what is left to pay the bank.
Yes, USD 1.8m is realistic, the full-service agreement covers everything and the DSCR is fine.
Max debt is 65.3m with these costs.
The 1.8m only holds during the warranty; from year 6 it is 3.0m, so max debt drops from 65.3m to 58.2m.
Northpoint already uses 155m of its 200m line with us, so we keep 45m and sell the balance to other lenders.
Yes, we can hold all 69.75m on our balance sheet, the group is a strong listed client.
Group limit: hold 45m, syndicate the rest.
No. We need to know who ultimately owns the 25% held through the BVI vehicle before we sign; I will send them the document list today so Friday is still possible.
Yes, Northpoint is listed so its KYC covers Silverbay, let's close on Friday.
KYC is not required for minority shareholders, so we can skip it.
